local_gram_and_radius_review.shared_input_scope: The frozen catalogue supplies completeness and finite deletions; the graph distances and literal new Gram calculations are independently recomputed here.

convex_transfer_review.analytic_sign_pattern: Positive outside j=a..b; negative inside; symmetric, mass0 and mean0.
convex_transfer_review.convex_order_argument: Choose the chord of an arbitrary convex test function through centered points ±(b−a+1)/2. Its difference from the chord is nonpositive on the negative-mass interval and nonnegative on the positive-mass tails. The chord contributes zero by mass and mean, proving convex order. Independent convolution preserves it.
